summary: Trivial accessor: calls CustomMemoryPoolAllocatorInit() and returns the int value stored at the head of the returned object (dereference of the init result). Callers ResourcePoolNodeAllocDealloc and LinkedListNodePrepend suggest the value read is a shared allocator/pool state cell used by pool and list allocation paths.

operations.description: Call CustomMemoryPoolAllocatorInit() to obtain a pointer to the custom memory pool allocator state.
Dereference the pointer returned by the init call and return the int value stored there.

unresolved: Identity and meaning of the dereferenced int at the head of the allocator-init object; the field is unnamed in the packet.
Why both allocator pool and linked-list prepend paths read this value.
Whether the dereferenced value is a counter, capability flag, or pool configuration field.
